args.body: Hi Dora! I visited your personal website. It's clean and simple, and having your email address up front makes you easy to contact. It would be even better with more content, such as a short bio, your projects or interests, and some visuals. Nice work!

final_text:
I visited both websites and sent each person feedback by direct message.

- **Dora:** I invited her to Slack using the email on her site (dora@securemail-hub.com), then messaged her. I said the site is clean and simple and that the visible email makes her easy to contact. I suggested adding a short bio, projects or interests, and some visuals.
- **Eve:** I said her blog has a personal touch and that her love of hiking comes through. I suggested adding hiking stories, trail recommendations, photos, and a way for readers to subscribe or comment.
